reuse.why: Extends the existing exclusion helper (formerly getTemplatedCategoryIds) that all six month-wide actions already consult.

duplication.why: The #fixed rule is written once inside the shared helper; call sites only change the function name.

placement.why: Stays in budget/actions.ts inside the helper the tree uses for month-wide exclusions.

scope.why: Only the helper and the renamed calls change.

maintainability.why: Renaming to getProtectedCategoryIds with a comment clarifies intent, though the local variables are still called 'templated' and no test accompanies the change.

one_place.where: getProtectedCategoryIds in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, called by copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending and set3/6/12MonthAvg.
